resources.string: Calendar and contacts on this phone
Show your NoDrive calendars and contacts in this phone\'s Calendar and Contacts apps. Changes go both ways. Tasks stay in NoAgenda.
Tasks stay in NoAgenda; your phone\'s calendar has no tasks.
NoDrive needs access to this phone\'s calendars and contacts to put your NoDrive ones there.
Without access NoDrive can\'t add your calendars and contacts. You can allow it in the phone\'s settings.
